findings.evidence: diff.txt:896-898 shows context line `Copyright (c) 2026 daouid. All rights reserved.` with `+Authors: The Tau Ceti contributors`; `grep -rh '^Authors:' TauCeti` on the head tree gives 165 `Authors: Chris Birkbeck`, showing named humans do get named Authors lines in this repo.
findings.fix: Write `Authors: daouid` instead, matching the copyright line (as is done for the 165 `Copyright (c) 2026 Chris Birkbeck` files, which keep `Authors: Chris Birkbeck`).
findings.issue: The file's copyright is held by a named contributor (`Copyright (c) 2026 daouid`), but the PR adds `Authors: The Tau Ceti contributors`, crediting the collective for a file whose rights line names an individual. This contradicts the PR's own stated rule that every named credit is preserved; it is the only file in the diff where a named copyright holder receives a collective Authors line.

findings.evidence: diff.txt:5963-5968 removes the `## References` block with the URL; `grep -rn 'AINTLIB' TauCeti` shows the convention of including `github.com/CBirkbeck/AINTLIB` in the docstring (e.g. Algebra/CubicDiscriminant.lean:30, AlgebraicGeometry/AdicSpace/Spa/Comap.lean:49, EllipticCurve/Affine/FunctionField/Finrank.lean:74), and the URL now appears nowhere in FundamentalDomain.lean.
findings.fix: Add the repository pointer to the docstring porting note, matching the house style used elsewhere, e.g. "Ported from the AINTLIB `LeanModularForms` project (`github.com/CBirkbeck/AINTLIB`, Apache-2.0), `LeanModularForms/Modularforms/PeterssonLevelN.lean`".
findings.issue: The removed copyright-block references carried the upstream URL `<https://github.com/CBirkbeck/AINTLIB/tree/main/projects/LeanModularForms>`; the surviving docstring note (lines 34-36) names the project and file but no longer contains any repository pointer, so the PR strips the file's only link to the source it is ported from.

summary: The sweep preserves human Authors lines everywhere except one file, where a human copyright holder's file is given a collective Authors line, and it drops the only pointer to an upstream AINTLIB source. Everything else in the 972-file diff is a clean assistant-name normalization.
